Summary:

Through this refactoring, the project evolved from a single-use notebook into a maintainable machine learning codebase. It is now organized into separate modules — config.py, data.py, model.py,train.py,use.py,utils.py, ./test/test_smoke.py, project.py (the main entry point). The original implementation was contained in q_rnn_last_name.ipynb.
